traps: composer.json (wallabag/wallabag) and package.json (wallabag) share the root: Symfony, Doctrine ORM, Twig and JMS Serializer belong to the first, webpack, Encore, Stimulus and Materialize to the second
the default store is SQLite; MySQL, MariaDB and PostgreSQL are commented DATABASE_URL lines in .env and commented services in compose.yaml, with docker/mariadb/env and docker/postgres/env beside them
compose.yaml starts only Redis next to the app; RabbitMQ is configured by RABBITMQ_URL and a commented compose service, and Redis or RabbitMQ carry the asynchronous import queues
Matomo is a setting in app/config/wallabag.yml with a default host, not a dependency
Gmail is a Symfony Mailer transport package; Google Authenticator in scheb_two_factor is a local TOTP check, not a service
@codecov/webpack-plugin and the commented Blackfire service are developer tooling, not services of the application
only frameworks and services are measured; the other facets are in unknown
